assessment.authority: The original R3 grant persists. This proposal grants nothing and requests only the additional metadata needed by the two named connector routes.
assessment.privacy: The disclosure truthfully identifies unavoidable upstream editor attribution and spreadsheet URL exposure. It requires discarding personal attribution and unnecessary metadata before model-facing output or evidence persistence. Other-tab inventory and revision contents remain prohibited.
assessment.bounds: Revision reads are capped at one page of 1000 records per observation, four observations per attempt and three attempts. Cell reads retain the original workbook, sheet0, A1:O417 and exact cell projection.
assessment.revisionProof: A nonempty tool-reported currentRevisionId must have a corresponding revision record agreeing with independently observed file modifiedTime. Ambiguity, the record cap or unavailable proof keeps processing blocked. Historical revision229, modifiedTime alone and the last listed revision are explicitly insufficient.
assessment.captureGates: Before/after equal revision tokens, two equal complete bounded projections, identity/header/dimension checks and mapping review before product edits remain required.
assessment.trashedStatus: Unavailable remains unknown. The proposal does not infer trashed:false or waive an applicable trash-status gate.
assessment.continuation: Supplemental approval must precede prospective policy/state/test changes and fresh independent policy review. Additional source calls remain blocked until that sequence is satisfied.
assessment.release: No R4 effects, canonical acceptance, attestation, publication or deployment are authorized.
